subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and merge these updated third-party action revisions in workflows that receive app keys, registry credentials, security-upload permissions, or OpenAI API keys?
rationale: Automated checks can validate workflow behavior but cannot make the repository's trust decision for newly selected third-party code revisions running inside privileged jobs.

options.title: Approve After Refresh
options.body: Refresh onto current main, complete exact-head checks, and approve the reviewed revisions as one dependency batch.

options.title: Split Privileged Actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, security, and agent actions from routine setup-action updates to reduce review and rollback scope.

options.title: Hold The Batch
options.body: Keep the existing pins until workflow owners can establish revision provenance and operational readiness.

recommendation.title: Approve After Refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, complete exact-head checks, and approve the reviewed revisions as one dependency batch.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to release workflow execution and recent hardening of the affected Docker and full-release paths.
